purpose: Coordinate claim routing, supplied verification evidence, conflict holding, human-review requirements, release-gate preparation, and proof-export references without acquiring decision authority.

inputs.claims: typed claim identifiers with subject and scope references
inputs.profile: explicit claim-type requirements, proof surfaces, verifier identifiers, and review conditions
inputs.release_context: artifact identity, rollback reference, and proof-export reference

outputs.coordination_packet: deterministic per-claim readiness, selected organs, unresolved seams, and external-gate preparation state

refusals: non-boolean freshness, independence, conflict, or authority flags
